title: Skull Vortex Over Seaside
description: A giant metallic skull with a spiraling colorful vortex emerging from its cranium rises from turbulent ocean waves. A small red house with a striped roof sits on the sandy beach to the left, surrounded by white picket fence pieces, while golden particles stream from the skull's mouth toward the house.
prompt: Surreal scene of a massive metallic human skull emerging from a stormy sea, its cranium replaced by a swirling colorful vortex of purple, teal, orange and black shapes with orbiting dotted rings. Golden particles flow from its open jaw toward a small red wooden house with striped roof sitting on the beach. Turbulent waves with colorful swirling patterns at the base, dramatic cloudy sky, highly detailed digital painting in a vibrant psychedelic style.
